# REST API Contract Specification (docs/api-contract.md) — Architecture V2

## 1. Protocol Standards & Headers

- **Base URL**: `/api/v1` (or `/api`)
- **Transport**: HTTPS with TLS 1.3
- **Payload Format**: `application/json; charset=utf-8`
- **File Uploads**: `multipart/form-data`
- **Mandatory Disclaimer Header**: Every HTTP response contains:
  `X-Legal-Disclaimer: Automated AI analysis for informational purposes only. Not legal advice.`
- **Standard Envelope**:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "data": { ... },
    "disclaimer": "This analysis is generated by an automated AI system for educational and informational review. It does not constitute legal advice and cannot substitute for qualified legal counsel.",
    "request_id": "req-9b1deb4d-3b7d",
    "timestamp": "2026-09-26T21:00:00.000Z"
  }
  ```

---

## 2. API Endpoints Catalog

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET` | `/api/health` | Service health, DB, Redis, BullMQ, and AI status |
| `POST` | `/api/documents/upload` | Multipart file upload (`file`, `documentType`, `jurisdiction`) |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/:id/status` | Polling state (`queued`, `processing`, `analyzed`, `failed`) |
| `POST` | `/api/documents/:id/analyze` | Idempotent queue trigger / retry |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/:id/analysis` | Complete audit summary, key findings & cost metrics |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/:id/clauses` | Array of parsed clauses with risk levels & benchmarks |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/:id/clauses/:clauseId` | Single clause detail with benchmark diff & counter-draft |
| `POST` | `/api/documents/:id/clauses/:clauseId/counter-draft` | Re-generate or customize counter-draft |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/:id/gotchas` | Executive "Before You Sign" Gotchas deck |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/:id/checklist` | **Pre-Signing Action Checklist** |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/:id/attorney-brief` | **Attorney Consultation Preparation Dossier** |
| `POST` | `/api/documents/:id/query` | **Interactive Document Q&A (RAG query)** |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/:id/export` | **Export Complete Audit Dossier (Markdown / PDF)** |
| `GET` | `/api/benchmarks` | Catalog of market benchmark standards |

---

## 3. Detailed Endpoint Contracts

### 3.1 `POST /api/documents/upload`
Uploads a contract. Enforces 5 MB size limit and scanned document check.

- **Content-Type**: `multipart/form-data`
- **Form Fields**:
  - `file` *(binary, required)*: PDF or plain text contract.
  - `documentType` *(string, optional)*: `general_contract` | `nda` | `employment` | `lease` | `saas_msa`.
  - `jurisdiction` *(string, optional)*: `General Commercial` | `US-General` | `US-CA` | `US-NY` | `UK` | `India`. Default: `General Commercial`.
- **Response `201 Created`**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "document_id": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "job_id": "job:doc:9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "filename": "consulting_agreement.pdf",
    "file_size_bytes": 145020,
    "mime_type": "application/pdf",
    "jurisdiction": "US-General",
    "status": "queued",
    "clause_count": 18,
    "created_at": "2026-09-26T21:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

---

### 3.2 `GET /api/documents/:id/status`
Polls live progress of the BullMQ analysis worker.

- **Response `200 OK`**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "document_id": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "status": "processing", // queued | processing | analyzed | failed
    "progress_percentage": 65,
    "total_clauses": 18,
    "processed_clauses": 12,
    "is_scanned": false,
    "error": null
  }
}
```

---

Aggregated audit overview, risk tier counts, executive summary, and cost telemetry.

- **Response `200 OK`**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "document_id": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "filename": "consulting_agreement.pdf",
    "document_type": "general_contract",
    "jurisdiction": "US-General",
    "status": "analyzed",
    "overall_risk_score": 0.72,
    "risk_summary": {
      "total_clauses": 18,
      "standard": 11,
      "caution": 4,
      "unfavorable": 3
    },
    "executive_summary": "This consulting agreement strongly favors the client, primarily due to unilateral uncapped indemnity and a broad 2-year non-compete.",
    "key_findings": [
      "Unilateral uncapped indemnity found in Section 8",
      "Perpetual non-compete clause found in Section 12",
      "Subjective payment acceptance criteria in Section 3"

    "telemetry": {
      "total_prompt_tokens": 12450,

      "estimated_cost_usd": 0.0042,
      "processing_latency_ms": 11840
    },
    "created_at": "2026-09-26T21:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

### 3.4 `GET /api/documents/:id/checklist`
Actionable pre-signing operational verification points generated by `GotchasAgent`.

- **Response `200 OK`**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "document_id": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "checklist": [
      {
        "id": "chk-001",
        "priority": 1,
        "item": "Request written clarification on invoice dispute cure period",
        "category": "Payment Terms",
        "status": "Action Required",
        "impact_rationale": "Currently, Section 3.2 allows withholding payment indefinitely without notice."
      },
      {
        "id": "chk-002",
        "priority": 2,
        "item": "Verify background IP carve-out schedule is attached as Exhibit A",
        "category": "Intellectual Property",
        "status": "Action Required",
        "impact_rationale": "Section 9 forfeits all prior inventions unless explicitly listed in Exhibit A."
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### 3.5 `GET /api/documents/:id/attorney-brief`
Structured dossier designed for the user to bring to a consultation with a licensed lawyer.

- **Response `200 OK`**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "document_id": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "jurisdiction": "US-General",
    "consultation_questions": [
      {
        "priority": 1,
        "clause_ref": "Section 8.1 (Indemnification)",
        "question": "Is an uncapped indemnity clause enforceable for independent contractors under this state's law, and what standard liability cap should we insist on?",
        "context_summary": "Clause requires contractor to indemnify client for third-party claims without negligence carve-out or dollar limit."
      },
      {
        "priority": 2,
        "clause_ref": "Section 12.3 (Restrictive Covenant)",
        "question": "Does this 2-year nationwide non-compete violate recent FTC regulations or state restrictive covenant limits?",
        "context_summary": "Prohibits contractor from performing any services in the tech industry for 24 months."
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### 3.6 `POST /api/documents/:id/query`
Interactive Document Q&A endpoint powered by `LegalInquiryAgent`.

- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "question": "What happens if I terminate this contract early?"
}
```
- **Response `200 OK`**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "document_id": "9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d",
    "question": "What happens if I terminate this contract early?",
    "answer": "Under Section 11.2, you may terminate for convenience by providing 30 days prior written notice. However, Section 11.4 states you will only be compensated for milestones accepted in writing prior to the termination notice date.",
    "grounding_citations": [
      {
        "clause_id": "c1f77d3b-9a40-4df2-a9b1-7a8efb542011",
        "section_number": "11.2",
        "title": "Termination for Convenience",
        "relevance_score": 0.91
      },
      {
        "clause_id": "c1f77d3b-9a40-4df2-a9b1-7a8efb542013",
        "section_number": "11.4",
        "title": "Payment Upon Termination",
        "relevance_score": 0.88
      }
    ],
    "suggested_follow_ups": [
      "Can the client terminate without notice?",
      "Are there termination penalties or liquidated damages?"
    ]
  }
}
```

---

### 3.7 `GET /api/documents/:id/export`
Exports a comprehensive audit dossier.

- **Query Parameters**:
  - `format` *(string, optional)*: `markdown` | `pdf`. Default: `markdown`.
- **Response `200 OK`**:
  Returns formatted Markdown string or binary PDF stream with prominent legal disclaimer banner and redlined negotiation drafts.

---

## 4. Standard Error Codes Matrix

| HTTP Status | Error Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `400 Bad Request` | `VALIDATION_FAILED` | Payload failed Zod schema validation |
| `400 Bad Request` | `INVALID_FILE_FORMAT` | File is not valid PDF or plain text |
| `413 Payload Too Large` | `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | File exceeds maximum permitted limit (5 MB) |
| `404 Not Found` | `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` | Specified document UUID does not exist |
| `404 Not Found` | `CLAUSE_NOT_FOUND` | Specified clause UUID does not exist |
| `422 Unprocessable` | `DOCUMENT_REQUIRES_OCR` | Document is an image-only scan ($< 50$ chars/page) |
| `422 Unprocessable` | `EXTRACTION_FAILED` | File stream is password-protected or unreadable |
| `429 Too Many Requests` | `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Request rate limit exceeded (60 RPM) |
| `503 Service Unavailable` | `AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | External LLM API is unreachable |
